name.description: The name of the component that this control will use. Defaults to the key if not provided.

key.description: The name of the key that this control will be associated with.

path.description: The directory to create the component in.

interfaceSuffix.description: The suffix of the interface. Defaults to 'GroupConfig'

componentSuffix.description: The suffix of the component. Defaults to 'Group'

interfaceFileSuffix.description: Segment before '.ts' in the interface file name (e.g. 'type' -> name.type.ts). Defaults to 'type' only when the component has a type suffix.

schematicsConfig.description: The schematics configuration file to use
